app.name: MindNote
app.startupError: Could not open the local vault: {{message}}
app.changedElsewhere: This document changed in another tab.

startup.title: This browser's vault cannot be opened
startup.explanation: Nothing has been deleted. It may be a temporary browser lock, private browsing, or a vault created by a newer version of the app.
startup.temporaryBanner: Temporary in-memory vault: everything here is lost when the tab closes. Use “Emergency export” before leaving.

library.title: Library
library.purgeConfirm: Permanently delete “{{title}}” and all its versions? This cannot be undone. Make a backup first if you need one.
library.createInside: New items go inside “{{folder}}”. Click the folder again to create at the root.
library.trashFolder: Move folder to trash (its content is not deleted)
library.recoveryHint: Documents whose folder is in the trash or no longer exists. Move them to another folder.

readOnly.unsupported-version: This document uses a newer format version than this app. It is shown read-only so nothing is lost.
readOnly.invalid-content: This document does not match the expected format. It is shown read-only; see “Status and diagnostics”.

notes.invalidFrontmatter: This note's frontmatter is not valid; it is kept as text.

statusPanel.title: Status and diagnostics
statusPanel.persistedNo: No: the browser may delete data if it needs space
statusPanel.quotaHigh: Storage is almost full. Make an emergency export and free some space.
statusPanel.backupNote: Browser storage is not a substitute for a backup.
statusPanel.emergencyExportHint: Downloads all local content (documents, versions and files) as a single JSON file. Interim until the ZIP backup.
statusPanel.diagnosticsHint: Kept on this device only; it does not contain your notes' text.
statusPanel.licensesHint: This app is free software under the MIT license and includes third-party software and fonts.

storageAlert.outOfSpace: Out of space: changes are NOT being saved.

errors.quota-exceeded: Browser storage is full. The change was NOT saved.
errors.storage-failure: Local save failed. The change was NOT saved.
errors.unsupported-version: Unsupported format version: the document is read-only.

pwa.updateFailed: Not updated: some changes could not be saved.
pwa.offlineReady: The app is ready to work offline.

canvas.draftRecovered: A stroke left unfinished when the app closed was recovered.

history.title: Version history
history.hint: Every saved version is kept until you delete the document from the trash.

conflict.title: Resolve conflict
conflict.banner: This document has conflicting versions. None has been lost.
conflict.explanation: The same document changed in two places at once. Choose what to keep: the other versions stay in the history.
conflict.bothHint: {{a}} stays in this document and {{b}} is copied to a new document.

vaults.title: Vaults in this browser
vaults.backupHint: Downloads a ZIP with the whole vault in the open format: documents, history, trash and a manifest with each file’s SHA-256.
vaults.largeBackup: The backup is about {{mb}} MB. Creating it may use a lot of memory, especially on iPad. Continue?
vaults.restoreHint: Restoring creates a NEW vault with the backup’s content; the current vault is untouched.
vaults.restore: Restore a backup (ZIP or emergency JSON)…
vaults.identical: Verified: the restored content matches the backup byte for byte.
vaults.notIdentical: Warning: the restored content does not exactly match the backup.
vaults.problems: {{count}} warnings while reading the backup (see diagnostics).

search.placeholder: Search notes, titles, tags and canvases
